headline: Executive order directs the federal government to end its diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) programs and preferences.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this executive order tells the federal government to stop its diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) programs. It also appears to end preferences in government programs or decisions linked to DEI. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, programs, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: Agencies would be directed to end DEI programs and related preferences they run.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees who work in DEI programs
who_it_affects.how: Their programs or roles may be ended or changed as agencies stop DEI work.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; the material provided does not list specific deadlines.
